summary_en: Studies show that training AI systems to follow rules works for single models but fails when multiple AI agents work together.
Researchers tested this on tasks like medical triage and news recommendation, finding that more capable models don't always perform better in team settings.
Some methods to fix alignment issues work, while others don't consistently improve team performance
key_points_en: AI alignment problems vary unpredictably with model capability
Mythos Preview showed both largest and smallest safety gaps across different tasks
Simple interventions sometimes help but often fail in multi-agent teams
translation_zh: 研究表明，训练AI系统遵守规则对单个模型有效，但多个AI代理协作时会失败。
研究人员在医疗分诊和新闻推荐任务中测试发现，能力更强的模型在团队设置中表现并不一定更好。
一些解决对齐问题的方法有效，但其他方法在多代理团队中经常失败

vocab.zh: 使AI遵循规则的训练方法
AI团队中出现的安全性能差异

items.title_en: New Method Makes AI Models More Transparent
summary_en: Neural networks are good at predictions but hard to explain, which limits their use in science. A new approach called iWSP creates interpretable models by programming weights directly in code, avoiding traditional training methods.
This method helps explain brain activity predictions in neuroscience by making model features clear.
The technique uses code instead of gradient-based training to build models that are easier to understand.
key_points_en: Neural networks lack transparency for scientific use
iWSP builds models without backpropagation
Method reveals which features drive predictions
translation_zh: 神经网络擅长预测但难以解释，这限制了其在科学中的应用。一种名为iWSP的新方法通过直接在代码中编程权重来创建可解释的模型，避免使用传统训练方法。
该方法通过使模型特征清晰，帮助解释神经科学中的大脑活动预测。
该技术使用代码而非基于梯度的训练来构建更易理解的模型。

items.title_en: AscendGYM: A New Benchmark for Optimizing AI Kernels on Ascend NPUs
summary_en: Kernel optimization is crucial for efficient AI training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Current benchmarks focus more on kernel generation than on improving existing implementations with real-world data.
AscendGYM introduces 48 test kernels across three difficulty levels, using real training and inference data to measure optimization effectiveness.
key_points_en: Focuses on optimizing existing kernel implementations
Uses 48 kernels from real AI workloads
Measures performance improvements for real tasks
translation_zh: 内核优化对于在Ascend NPUs上高效进行AI训练和推理至关重要。当前的基准测试更关注内核生成，而不是用真实数据改进现有实现。
AscendGYM引入了三个难度级别的48个测试内核，使用真实训练和推理数据来衡量优化效果。

vocab.zh: 内核优化（提升AI计算效率的技术）
真实工作负载（实际应用中的计算任务）
性能提升（系统运行效率的提高）
输入配置（影响计算的参数设置）
测试用例（验证系统表现的实例）
